module: Backward compatibility layer: reproduces the old `drivetrain` API by reading the devices of the new `powertrain` system ('mainEngine' and 'gearbox') every frame. An old mod or script that reads drivetrain.rpm, drivetrain.gear, drivetrain.torque... keeps working. New developments should use powertrain directly.
usage:
local rpm = drivetrain.rpm
local gear = drivetrain.gear
drivetrain.shiftToGear(1)
notes: The fields are recomputed by updateProxy (updateGFX) every frame from powertrain.getDevice('mainEngine') and ('gearbox'). rpm = engine outputAV1 * 9.5493 (rad/s to RPM).
updateProxy also writes electrics.values.gear_M = gearbox gearIndex (key read by the UI).

Fields never updated by updateProxy (keep their initial value): brake, fuelLeakRate, fuel, fuelCapacity, fuelUsage, shifterPosition, wheelCount, avgAV. M.shifterMode is forced to 2 every frame. M.esc is an array of nop functions.
M.engineAV is nil if the 'mainEngine' engine does not exist (the other fields fall back to 0); init does not reset it to zero.
setShifterMode: only mode 2 gives 'arcade', any other mode gives 'realistic' (modes 0, 1 and 3 are not distinguished).

engineAV.desc: Engine angular velocity (rad/s) or nil without a main engine.

esc.desc: Fake compatibility ESC object: update, updateGFX, toggleESCMode, getCarData are nop, escPulse = 0.

init.desc: Called at init and reset: assigns M.wheels and resets rpm, engineDisabled, gear, torqueTransmission and engineLoad to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame (updateProxy): copies the state of the main engine and gearbox into the drivetrain fields.

setShifterMode.desc: Sets the gearbox mode: mode 2 gives 'arcade', any other value 'realistic' (controller.mainController.setGearboxMode).

v.desc: 0 manual, 1 manual with auto clutch, 2 arcade, 3 realistic automatic (code comment).
